Accordion Component (<x-accordion />)

1. Single Panel Expand (Outline Variant)

Aegis UI is an unstyled & token-driven Blade + Livewire component package built specifically for Laravel 13, Livewire 4, Alpine.js 3, and Tailwind CSS 4.
Require the package via Composer using composer require aegis/ui and publish the custom CSS design tokens.
Absolutely! Every visual value references a --ui-* custom property defined inside the @theme {} CSS block.

2. Multi-Expand Mode (Soft Variant)

Multiple panels can stay open simultaneously when multiple="true" is enabled on the accordion container.
Smooth height expansion animations are powered by Alpine's x-collapse directive.
